title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: GPS Annual Day Celebration is held in high esteem every year. This is the most well known and celebrated function of GPS as majority of the students and former students participate in the programmes held on that day. The public meeting starts by around 6.30 pm where invited guests from the film industry, political field, etc. participate to inaugurate the function and to distribute the prizes for the students who have scored A1 for AISSCE and AISSE. Prizes are also distributed to the Literary, Cultural and Sports Champions and also to the students from each class who have performed the best. The School Magazine is also released on that day. Variety entertainments are showcased by the students after the public meeting.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: The School is affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary Education and the medium of instruction is English.

We provide a platform for active involvement of the students in all the domains of development. Apart from the subjects offered for primary classes we give utmost importance to co-curricular activities like dance, music, art, craft, physical education etc.

To develop the creative talents, the students of classes III to X are assessed in co-curricular activities like Keyboard, Western Music , Light Music, Dance, Band, Chess, Table Tennis, Handball, Basketball, Throwball, Volleyball, Teakwondo, Home Science, Art, Craft and Yoga. Well trained and experienced tutors equip the students to perform their best according to their skills and interests.

For classes IX & X, the overall performance of the students is based on their achievement in scholastic & co-scholastic areas. In co-scholastic areas we assess life skills, literary and creative skills, scientific skills, work education, drawing & painting, attitude & values, health & physical education and first aid.

Students of classes XI & XII are continuously evaluated on the basis of their performance in class tests, cyclic tests, midterm and terminal exams in an academic year. For the students of class X and XII we conduct model exams to equip them to face the board examination confidently.

These digital classrooms envisage a practical aspect of learning rather than the age old system of theoretical learning in the classrooms.

Dear Parents,
In order to inculcate a feeling of equality and a sense of belonging to the institution, the students are required to adhere to the following norms of the school. We expect your wholehearted cooperation in observing these norms.

▪️The school will reopen for classes I – X & XII on Wednesday, 1st June 2022.
Timing : 8:00am – 3.00pm.
▪️School bus facility shall be available from the month of June. Those who wish to avail the school bus facility may fill the Google Form link given below:
▪️Students should be dressed neatly in proper School uniform (Black Uniform)
▪️In order to maintain uniformity, students are expected to bring only black bags to school.
▪️Girls with long hair should tie a pony tail or have a single plait using only black hair band or clips. No hair colouring is allowed. Nails should be clipped short.
▪️Boys shall have a proper shave and hair cut, polished shoes, combed hair and nails clipped short. No hair colouring is allowed.
▪️Campus language – English to be strictly followed both inside and outside the school campus.
▪️Textbooks and notebooks are to be neatly maintained.
▪️Students are strictly prohibited from going outside the school campus during school hours.
▪️Mobile phones strictly not allowed in the school campus.
▪️Students suffering from contagious diseases are requested to stay at home until they fully recover.

Our key priority remains the same – to keep our students safe and to help them to get on with their educational journey as smooth as possible. We expect your whole hearted support in these circumstances.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: A Legacy of Excellence in Education

Established in 1985 as a modest kindergarten, Greets Public School has flourished into a premier co-educational senior secondary institution, affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education. Over the past four decades, the school has become a beacon of quality education in Kochi, offering an unparalleled learning experience with an unabated emphasis on discipline.

Founded under the aegis of the Bethel Foundation, the school was envisioned by the principal promoters of the organisation, the late Ms. Edith Virginia Greet and the late Shri Thomas Vadakekut. Their foundational efforts and visionary leadership laid a solid platform for the school’s growth. Shri Thomas Vadakekut, as former Chairman, provided strategic guidance, emphasizing integrity, academic rigour and all-rounded development.

Greets Public School has consistently maintained a record of exceptional academic achievement. Students have secured excellent results in the CBSE board examinations year after year, with many topping in various subjects and achieving full A1 grades. These academic milestones reflect the school’s commitment to providing superior quality teaching and fostering a competitive academic atmosphere.

Alongside academics, the school places great importance on preserving and promoting India’s rich cultural heritage. A wide array of cultural programmes, festivals and both inter-school and intra-school competitions are conducted throughout the year, enabling students to express their creativity while learning about the diverse traditions of our country.

The school’s mission is to integrate state-of-the-art facilities with progressive educational practices, nurturing students into capable, responsible and ethical citizens of the 21st century. With an unwavering commitment to excellence, a team of dedicated educators and a vibrant student community, Greets Public School continues to stand tall as an institution where tradition meets innovation, preparing students to lead with knowledge, integrity and compassion.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: To impart a healthy competitive spirit, to develop team work and to give training in leadership, a House System has been introduced.
There are four Houses, namely DIAMOND, EMERALD, RUBY and SAPPHIRE.

Each student must belong to a House and each House is headed by a  Teacher co – ordinator, a Captain and an Assistant Captain.Lot of activities and competitions are conducted house wise and the overall winners will be awarded on the annual day.  The house with maximum points will be given a trophy.

title: Greets Public School - Excellence in Education
paragraphs: Educational Efficacy & Holistic Development in the Heart of Kochi

The historical trajectory of Greets Public School reveals a deliberate, phased expansion driven by localized socio-educational demands and strategic philanthropic vision. Anchored in the establishment of the Bethel Foundation in 1975, our roots trace back to a modest early-childhood learning center christened "Ding Dong Kindergarten".

Upgraded to a comprehensive English Medium School in 1986 and provisionally affiliated with the CBSE in 1991, GPS has transformed into a sprawling, technologically integrated senior secondary institution under the visionary leadership of our founders.
A holistic approach augmenting standard academics with co-curricular disciplines like Music, Dance, Chess, and Taekwondo to build psychomotor skills and creative thinking.
Rigorous academic evaluation integrating specialized vocational subjects like Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, and Financial Markets for pre-professional competencies.
Intensive specialization in Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams, designed to funnel students toward highly competitive tertiary educational pathways with a 100% success rate.
GPS maintains a perfect 100% pass rate across all registered candidates in secondary and senior secondary phases, cementing our position at the apex of academic achievement.
To counteract urban externalities and tropical heat, our 7,784 sq.m campus features centralized air conditioning across 37 expansive digital classrooms.
Massive, domain-specific spaces including a 103 sq.m Biology Lab, 78 sq.m Computer Lab, Physics, and Chemistry labs aligned with tertiary education pathways.
A 148 sq.m central library housing over 13,000 reference texts, fiction works, and periodicals to foster deep research and reading habits.
A proprietary fleet of air-conditioned buses outfitted with live CCTV surveillance, GPS tracking, and automatic safety doors for secure transit.
We believe in balancing intense academic pressure with highly structured cultural pageantry to cultivate a distinct institutional brand and ensure holistic student well-being.
Our premier high-octane inter-school dance, music, and fashion festival, drawing fierce competition and acting as a cultural vanguard in Ernakulam.
Our meticulously produced Annual Day award ceremony honoring academic toppers and cultural champions, often graced by high-profile regional celebrities.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: Ding Dong Kindergarten is the place where the tiny tots grow with a sense of self esteem and self worth. It is the first step towards independence and children enjoy learning and experience that learning is fun. Equipped with digital classroom, library and dedicated teachers, Ding Dong Kindergarten assists the children to develop into confident and well balanced adults. The spacious and colourful classrooms maximize their information retention and stimulate participation. The natural play area created inside the class rooms help them experience the lasting delights of childhood. Education approach is based on play way method, practical activities, fine motor development and social interaction. Thus, we aim to assist the children to develop into independent and proficient human beings.

As a step towards including experiential learning among small kids, a very joyful learning atmosphere has been created in the school which gives opportunity for students to do and learn through activities.

Besides, to nurture various aspects, holistic growth of children, different activities, like assembly programmes to celebrate important days and festivals, personality development activities like public speaking, stage performance  etc. are planned and executed.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: The Physics lab is equipped with a wide variety of apparatus which supplement and strengthen concepts learned in the class room. Experiments in Physics labs are explained to and done by students with care given to all intricate details of each of them. So that once imbibed, they remain in the young minds for future times.

Our Chemistry lab is equivalent to any other high graded chemistry lab. It is a place where students give practical shape to written work.The lab is equipped with all the apparatus and chemicals required for the performance of experiments like Salt Analysis, Volumetric Analysis etc. The student-friendly atmosphere in the lab helps to enrich the overall personality of the students through motivation and reinforcement.

Our spacious and well ventilated Biology Lab caters to the latest and most modern facilities. Keeping the latest syllabus in mind, the lab is a home to a wide variety of models, specimens, charts, chemicals etc. The lab ensures that the practical knowledge is placed on an equal footing with theoretical knowledge for the all round development of the student.

Mathematics lab is mainly meant for doing activities. A wide variety of teaching / learning aids are available in the lab which help the students to understand the concepts through relevant, meaningful and concrete activities.
A well equipped computer lab with internet facilities enables the student to attain the latest knowledge in Information Technology. Kindergarten students are taken once in a week to the lab.

“Explore. Experiment. Discover. — The Journey of Scientific Learning Begins Here.”Our Composite Science Laboratory is a vibrant hub where Physics, Chemistry, and Biology come together to inspire curiosity and innovation. Equipped with modern apparatus, scientific models, specimens, and safety features, the lab provides students with enriching hands-on experiences that transform learning into discovery and nurture a lifelong passion for science.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: The School has a well equipped library which is one of the best in the state, to enable the pupils to develop reading habits. It has a wide collection of books in English, Malayalam and Hindi for various academic and general subjects. The Kiddies Section of the library is colourful and fascinating to the tiny tots. Strict discipline and pindrop silence should be followed in the library; failing which, the student will not be allowed to enter the same.
Students of GPS and members of staff are entitled to borrow books from the library as per the following criteria.
For the students of Std IV onwards, fiction books are available on loan for a maximum of 2 weeks.

For the students of Std VIII onwards, reference books from certain sections are also available on loan for a maximum of 4 days.If the books are not returned on the specified date, a fine of Rs.5/- per day will be charged including due date and return date.

All the students are permitted to borrow books from the library during the summer holidays from 9.30 am to 12.00 noon. The criteria for borrowing the books will be same as mentioned above. Those who wish to avail  books from the library should be in school uniform.

title: Greets Public School - Excellence in Education
paragraphs: Educational Efficacy & Holistic Development in the Heart of Kochi

The historical trajectory of Greets Public School reveals a deliberate, phased expansion driven by localized socio-educational demands and strategic philanthropic vision. Anchored in the establishment of the Bethel Foundation in 1975, our roots trace back to a modest early-childhood learning center christened "Ding Dong Kindergarten".

Upgraded to a comprehensive English Medium School in 1986 and provisionally affiliated with the CBSE in 1991, GPS has transformed into a sprawling, technologically integrated senior secondary institution under the visionary leadership of our founders.
A holistic approach augmenting standard academics with co-curricular disciplines like Music, Dance, Chess, and Taekwondo to build psychomotor skills and creative thinking.
Rigorous academic evaluation integrating specialized vocational subjects like Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, and Financial Markets for pre-professional competencies.
Intensive specialization in Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams, designed to funnel students toward highly competitive tertiary educational pathways with a 100% success rate.
GPS maintains a perfect 100% pass rate across all registered candidates in secondary and senior secondary phases, cementing our position at the apex of academic achievement.
To counteract urban externalities and tropical heat, our 7,784 sq.m campus features centralized air conditioning across 37 expansive digital classrooms.
Massive, domain-specific spaces including a 103 sq.m Biology Lab, 78 sq.m Computer Lab, Physics, and Chemistry labs aligned with tertiary education pathways.
A 148 sq.m central library housing over 13,000 reference texts, fiction works, and periodicals to foster deep research and reading habits.
A proprietary fleet of air-conditioned buses outfitted with live CCTV surveillance, GPS tracking, and automatic safety doors for secure transit.
We believe in balancing intense academic pressure with highly structured cultural pageantry to cultivate a distinct institutional brand and ensure holistic student well-being.
Our premier high-octane inter-school dance, music, and fashion festival, drawing fierce competition and acting as a cultural vanguard in Ernakulam.
Our meticulously produced Annual Day award ceremony honoring academic toppers and cultural champions, often graced by high-profile regional celebrities.
© 2026 Greets Public School. All rights reserved.

title: Greets Public School
paragraphs: The morning session begins with the assembly at 07:55 AM, in which all students and staff members  participate. All  students assemble class-wise in the designated places according to their class for the morning assembly, with teachers.

During the assembly, all students observe proper decorum and solemnity befitting the occasion. After the prayer, pledge-taking, announcements, short speeches by students/teachers, etc, the regular classes for the day starts.

To give importance to the study and usage of our National Language, as well as our Mother Tongue, it is decided by the Management to conduct School Assembly in Malayalam on all Tuesdays, and in Hindi on all Thursdays. On all Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, assembly will be conducted in English.

To update students with the day to day happenings, news paper reading is encouraged through activities like news delivary on the spot, quiz based on newspaper articles etc. which will enhance their general knowledge.

All these items are included because the institution intends the participation of all the students whose talents differ. Systematic arrangements for organising the competitions are made in four or five stages. Talented organisers judge the students and the winners are awarded prizes and certificates. The team spirit of the four houses Diamond, Emerald, Ruby and Sapphire with able House captains shows a lot in the performance of group activities. Children enjoy a week of competitive spirit which enables them to develop their intellectual and cultural skills too.

The competitions are held category-wise and the champions of each category are awarded during the annual function. The management supports all the activities and provides all infrastructural encouragement for the development of the children.
